text:
Mikhail Sergachev has a point in nine straight games and is logging 25 minutes a night over his last ten, almost three more than before. Utah is leaning on him, and he's answering: 20 points in 17 games, 11 on the power play, plus 24 blocked shots.

The production is ahead of the player, though. His scoring rate sits at 2.94 points per 60 minutes, while our range for his true talent tops out at 2.31. Five goals on 2.41 expected, and a 13.5% shooting rate after 6% last season, will cool. Evolving-Hockey had him 88th of 215 defensemen at 0.7 wins above replacement in 2025-26: a decent year, not a star one.

What's real: the Mammoth get 58% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him stopping 17% of entries at his blue line (typical is 11%) and in the 94th percentile in primary shot assists. Our projection says about 76 points, built partly on the hot start. Our gut says the minutes are the part that sticks.
headline: Sergachev's point streak comes with a warning label
